newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Aug 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Aug 4.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Monday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Nikkei survey shows cutback in local sales branches by big companies picking up speed.
-- Japanese oil firms expand exports to Asian markets.
-- Japan to back Russia for APEC membership as part of plan to improve bilateral ties.
-- Government to set standards for geographical range for rear support of U.S. military operations.
-- Kokusai Denshin Denwa Co Ltd to tie up with DDI Corp. Move will cut telephone charges by about 20 percent.
-- Half of university presidents oppose or cautious about setting fixed terms for faculty members.
-- Government plans to freeze pay rises for several months.
-- Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd involved in other corporate racketeer payoff schemes through discretionary trading deals.
